title: webfetch.input
description: Versioned MCP business contract. Runtime validation is authoritative for external JSON.

format.description: Default applies to initial URL reads only; omitted format on continuation inherits the cursor format.

engine.description: Fetch strategy for new URL reads. static uses HTTP/readability; crawl4ai renders with a protected local Chromium; auto falls back only after static EXTRACTION_FAILED or under 80 visible HTML text characters. Requires pnpm crawl4ai:setup for browser rendering.
